operator_io_quirks: Mixed-case column names: Trade_Name, FDA_approved, Location, Product, Chromosome, OMIM, Porphyria — must be double-quoted with original spelling; lookup case-insensitive.
DDL uses backtick-quoted parent refs (`enzyme`("id")) — sqlparse/sqlite_master text must be copied verbatim into the clone.

All columns notnull=0 even for PKs (id, enzyme_id, medicine_id) — sqlite PK on INTEGER is rowid alias; composite PK on medicine_enzyme_interaction is NOT rowid, so NULL PK members would be allowed by DDL but rejected by PK uniqueness only.
Chromosome is TEXT but stores '3p21.1','10q25.2-q26.3' — cytoband strings, not numbers; String fuzzer will produce garbage but no crash.
OMIM is INT with 6-digit values (125290..606938) — Number fuzzer range [-10^scale,10^scale] with scale from type args (none) => default scale; values will be tiny vs 6-digit originals.
Product contains non-ASCII 'δ-Aminolevulinic acid' — String CHARSET a-zA-Z0-9() will never reproduce; UTF-8 write path must survive.
FDA_approved / interaction_type / Location are 2-value enums stored as text ('Yes'/'No', 'inhibitor'/'activitor' (sic), 'Mitochondrion'/'Cytosol').
Tiny tables (21/8/19 rows) — original_values sampling k=min(5,len) is fine; no max_rows_per_table concern.

medicine_enzyme_interaction has composite PK (enzyme_id, medicine_id) and two FKs to small parents — FK fill draws from parent's FINAL filtered column; parent PKs are single-col so no composite-parent issue.
No self-FK, no dangling FK, no unique/check constraints, no views/triggers/indexes in DDL.
enzyme_id distinct=6 < 8 enzymes, medicine_id distinct=13 < 21 medicines — original interaction table is sparse; TS will densify.
operator_ts_expectations: medicine.id, enzyme.id, enzyme.OMIM, medicine_enzyme_interaction.enzyme_id/medicine_id -> Number fuzzer: uniform in [-10^scale,10^scale] (scale default 0 => [-1,1]) then +-1/+-2 perturbation; PK columns get max_l0=inf so fresh draws never reused.
Number fuzzer on OMIM will emit values ~[-1,1] vs original 6-digit — implausible, drives FN on range predicates like OMIM > 100000.

name/Trade_Name/Product/Chromosome/Porphyria/Location/FDA_approved/interaction_type -> String fuzzer: random a-zA-Z0-9() strings length [0,20] with 0.5 contaminate; will not match 'Yes'/'No'/'inhibitor'/'activitor' unless literal pool supplies them.

String fuzzer on 2-value enums (FDA_approved, interaction_type, Location) will produce many distinct values — FP on GROUP BY / DISTINCT-count queries, FN on = 'Yes' style filters unless pool seeds them.
Date/Time/Bool/Bit fuzzers unused (no such declared types).

FK fill: medicine_enzyme_interaction.enzyme_id drawn with replacement from enzyme.id final values (post PK-dedup), medicine_id from medicine.id — referential integrity preserved, but composite PK dedup (sample_fresh_primary_keys) drops duplicate (enzyme_id,medicine_id) pairs, so interaction table shrinks vs requested size.
choose_table_sizes: level 0 = medicine, enzyme (no deps); level 1 = medicine_enzyme_interaction; sizes 1+30u and x4 capped 2500 — interaction table may be much larger than 19, densifying the join.

PK dedup on medicine.id / enzyme.id: Number fuzzer with max_l0=inf gives near-unique ints, so few drops; but small range [-1,1] means many collisions -> heavy PK dedup -> tiny tables -> FN on COUNT(*) queries.
String PK not present; all PKs numeric.
Literal pool from train SQL will seed 'Yes','No','inhibitor','activitor','Mitochondrion','Cytosol' if train queries filter on them — critical for enum equality predicates.
Known TS misses likely: FN from Number range mismatch on OMIM/id; FP from String fuzzer inventing enum values; FP from densified interaction table changing COUNT/join cardinalities.
